1. (Currently amended) A method for restoring efficiency of a photovoltaic cell, the method comprising: illuminating a photovoltaic cell such that the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least __five__ hours of solar illumination; and annealing the photovoltaic cell at a temperature above __ninety__ degrees Celsius for a minimum of __ten__ minutes, the annealing in response to illuminating the photovoltaic cell.

2. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell comprises a semiconductor wafer, and one of: wherein the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least __twenty__ hours of solar illumination; wherein the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least __sixteen__ hours of solar illumination while being heated to at least __fifty__ degrees Celsius; and wherein the photovoltaic cell is irradiated in sunlight using a solar concentrator for at least __ten__ hours, and wherein the solar concentrator increases the irradiance of solar illumination on the photovoltaic cell by a factor of __two__ to __five__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 2, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature above __one hundred thirty__ degrees Celsius, and wherein annealing the photovoltaic cell further comprises illuminating the photovoltaic cell.

4. (Currently amended) The method of Claim 3, wherein illuminating the photovoltaic cell while annealing of the photovoltaic cell is performed such that the photovoltaic cell receives a time integrated irradiance equivalent to at least __ten__ minutes of solar illumination.

5. (Original) The method of Claim 1, wherein the semiconductor wafer is a silicon semiconductor wafer.

6. (Original) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is annealed at a temperature between __one hundred forty__ degrees Celsius and __two hundred ten__ degrees Celsius for a minimum of __two__ hours.

7. (Original) The method of Claim 6, wherein the photovoltaic cell is a thin film photovoltaic cell.

8. (Original) The method of Claim 6, wherein the photovoltaic cell is an amorphous silicon thin film photovoltaic cell.

9. (Original) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is illuminated after manufacturing of the photovoltaic cell is complete such that the photovoltaic cell produces electricity when illuminated.

10. (Original) The method of Claim 1, wherein the photovoltaic cell is illuminated with a light source that simulates light from the sun.
